l.i: meos, quorum uirtus, φιλομαθία καὶ φιλαληθία[?] mihi magno est solatio, hortari consueuerim, uideretis: & ut exstaret publicum aliquod testimonium meae erga uos, & inclytam familiam Comitum ab Ostro-rog, obseruantiae ac studij: laudatissimo uestro nomini, Generosi Domini Comites, Praelectionum mearum in IONAM, poe-nitentiae praeconem, κεφάλαια[?], mediocri diligentia collecta & edita, nominatim in-scribere uisum est. Id officium, si pro excel-lete uestra uirtute & humanitate, optimā in partem acceperitis: exoptatū laboris mei fructum ad me reddisse iudicabo. Quodsu-perest, precor toto pectore Filium Dei, Do-minum nostrum Iesum Christum, ut uobis, Inclyti Domini Comites, ubertim bene-dicat, & uos ab omni malo clementer custo-diat, ad gloriam suam, & uestram ac sub-ditorum incolumitatem. Amen.

page.notes: The first word "meos" is a fragment from the previous page. The Greek words φιλομαθία, φιλαληθία and κεφάλαια are read from a small scan and are doubtful. Ostrorog is split across the line as "Oflro-/rog". "1 O N A M" is set with spaced capitals and is read here as IONAM. The scan has stains and foxing, but no legible text is lost.
